name: Goal 60d3a8 holder: two consecutive post-fix WOE windows graded with the five woe.* holder-behavior instruments
commandNote: grade.mts wraps collectGoalHolderBehaviorMetrics + rateGoalHolderBehavior from packages/operator-core/lib/goal-holder-behavior-metrics.ts and reads the live Postgres ledger (agent_modes goal lease, tool_invocations, coord_event_log, routine_loop_transitions, event_awaits). Holder resolved from agent_modes(mode='goal', goal_lease_epoch 19), not goals.metadata.
summary: Both consecutive 2h windows of goal 60d3a8 lease holder su-a70547cc were graded on rubric work-on-everything-stewardship-health against the five holder-behavior success measures. W1 (07:49:40Z-09:49:40Z, card EI-24951369356377001): 3 pass, 2 fail; each fail is filed as a goal-stamped defect naming its root cause (nudge-efficacy -> WI-10005938, NULL cancel_reason on superseded reminder watches, fixed and live on bg-host from 11:06Z; holder-plan-authorship -> WI-10005942, the signal-5 cluster detector was absent from the holder's serving build until 09:20:41Z). W2 (09:49:40Z-11:49:40Z, card EI-24961458823340256): 5 of 5 pass. W2 is the distinguishing test for W1's plan-authorship miss: once the detector reached the holder's build and the nudge WI-10005940 was filed, the holder dissolved the cluster with reasons. Both W2 owner reports (10:32:36Z, 11:31:30Z) were hand-checked against the ledger and found truthful.
scope: Live ledger reads only; the grading script is an uncommitted scratch wrapper around the committed metrics module. Grader-instrument defects found during the windows were fixed before the W2 card (WI-10005965 window-start cluster read; WI-10005942 early-nudge guard).

assertions.evidence: W1 07:49:40Z-09:49:40Z card EI-24951369356377001 and W2 09:49:40Z-11:49:40Z card EI-24961458823340256, both emitted on rubric work-on-everything-stewardship-health for holder su-a70547cc.
Each card rates holder-plan-authorship, ideation-yield, owner-report-truthfulness, stewardship-loop-liveness and nudge-efficacy from the instrument verdicts, with a window id and start/end.

W1 misses: nudge-efficacy -> WI-10005938 (root cause: registerAwait retire UPDATEs left cancel_reason NULL), plan-authorship -> WI-10005942 (root cause: signal-5 detector absent from holder serving build until 09:20:41Z). W2 has no misses.
W2 rated 5 of 5 pass after the fixes reached the holder's runtime.
